title: Kissed Crumbly Japanese Papelon Nabemono
description: A warm, comforting dish from Okinawa, featuring crumbly textures and aromatic flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and saut6 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add 1 cup of thinly sliced papelon and cook for 3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add 1 cup of crumbled bhuna and cook, stirring often, for 2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of sake, and 1 tablespoon of mirin.
Continue to cook for 1 minute, until the liquid has been absorbed.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and top with 1/4 cup of grated daikon radish.
Garnish with 1/4 cup of chopped scallions and serve hot.
